record.question: What is the 'mask image' in digital subtraction angiography?
options: The image taken after the contrast medium has been injected.
The image taken before the contrast medium has been injected, showing only the background anatomy.
The final subtracted image of the vessels.
The image with the highest pixel density.
record.explanation: Answer B: The image taken before the contrast medium has been injected, showing only the background anatomy.. The DSA mask is acquired before contrast and contains background anatomy for subtraction. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
